Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper, songwriter, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. He rose to fame in 2018 with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which became a viral sensation and eventually reached the Billboard Hot 100’s Top 10. Known for his unique offbeat flow, West Coast sound, and outspoken personality, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable figures in California’s rap scene. Throughout his career, he has collaborated with major artists, including Cardi B, YG, and Rich The Kid.

Beyond music, Blueface has remained a major topic on social media because of his personal life, family relationships, and highly publicized relationship with Chrisean Rock. Following his release from prison in 2025, he expanded his presence in the streaming world, regularly going viral for his unpredictable livestreams and interactions with family members. More recently, Blueface shared a wholesome moment with his father after flying him out to spend quality time together alongside Chrisean Rock’s family, giving fans a glimpse into a more personal side of the Los Angeles rapper.
